# Jericho Urbano

> Jericho Urbano is a Visual Artist and Web Developer specializing in immersive digital experiences, videography, interactive web applications, and narrative aesthetics.

Crafting high-impact interactive web applications, cinematic narratives, and brand identities with seamless motion physics, minimalist spatial layouts, and precision color science.

## Core Information
- Website: [Jericho Urbano Portfolio](https://portfolio-jerichourbano.vercel.app/)

- Location: Philippines (Available Worldwide / Remote)
- Timezone: Philippine Standard Time (GMT+8)

## Key Projects
- [Aero Carbon](https://portfolio-jerichourbano.vercel.app/projects): Interactive web application showcase.
- [Monster Camo](https://portfolio-jerichourbano.vercel.app/projects): Visual branding and cinematic media showcase.
- [Spectrum Shift](https://portfolio-jerichourbano.vercel.app/projects): Interactive motion design project.
- [Neon Matrix](https://portfolio-jerichourbano.vercel.app/projects): High-impact digital art installation.
- [Porcelain Flora](https://portfolio-jerichourbano.vercel.app/projects): Minimalist spatial layout design.
- [Obsidian Stealth](https://portfolio-jerichourbano.vercel.app/projects): Color-grade and branding showcase.
